counterfactuals.title: Isolate Subject (Remove Background)
counterfactuals.hypothesis: If the model relies on genuine subject anatomy, removing the background should preserve the prediction.

counterfactuals.title: Background Only (Subject Removed)
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Tests if background textures alone trigger wildlife/context priors without the subject.

counterfactuals.title: Defocus Background Texture
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Tests whether high-frequency background textures (e.g., snow crystals, ripples) drive tokens.

counterfactuals.title: Counterfactual: Arctic Snowfield
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Transplant subject into high-albedo snowy tundra to test domain shift invariance.

counterfactuals.title: Counterfactual: Temperate Forest
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Transplant subject into dense green woodland foliage to test domain shift invariance.

counterfactuals.title: Counterfactual: Arid Desert Dunes
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Transplant subject into warm sand & rocky canyon to test domain shift invariance.

counterfactuals.title: Counterfactual: Urban Environment
counterfactuals.hypothesis: Transplant subject into concrete & architectural textures to test domain shift invariance.

diagnosis.summary: The model attends to the dog subject for 'timber wolf' (29.3%), with noticeable environmental coupling: removing the background changes confidence by -11.4%, and counterfactual habitat swaps cause up to a 8.3% drop (in 'Urban Environment').
